text:
Nina (AE): Quick thread — BlueMarlin wants a 10-day POC focused on SSO + SCIM + RBAC. They have strict network allowlists and a security review due next week. Need checklist of deliverables we provide.
Sam (SE): Happy to run this. For POC deliverables we'll hand over: SP metadata XML, ACS URL, entityID, sample SAML assertion, SCIM base URL + bearer token, minimal runbook for mapping groups -> roles.
Carla (BlueMarlin): We run Okta and require group sync + SCIM deprovisioning. Also need an audit trail showing who changed role assignments.
Devon (Security): Audit trail OK — we emit admin audit events for RBAC changes. Confirm retention requirements?
Nina (AE): BlueMarlin asks for 18 months retention for audit logs and an exportable CSV. Is that doable on Hosted?
Devon (Security): Hosted supports 12 months by default, 18 months via enterprise retention add-on (legal signoff + pricing). Exports possible via console or API. Will require DPA amendment.
Carla (BlueMarlin): Also — can SCIM be configured to use mTLS? Our security team prefers mutual TLS for service integrations.
Sam (SE): We support TLS 1.2/1.3 for SCIM. mTLS is available for Dedicated customers or Hosted customers with enterprise network controls. For a short POC we can enable a scoped token over TLS if they can't do Dedicated.
Carla (BlueMarlin): For the allowlist, we need a fixed set of egress IPs to permit. Can you provide those for the POC?
Sam (SE): Yes. I'll DM the egress range list. Note: hosted egress ranges are shared and may change quarterly; if they need static IPs long-term, Dedicated/VPC is the path.
deploy-bot: new runbook created: https://redwood.company/runbooks/bluemarlin-poc-ssoscim — assigned to Sam
Sam (SE): POC plan suggestion: 1) Test tenant with 8 seats, 2) SCIM sync of 3 groups (eng, ops, devops) with deprovision test, 3) SSO configured via Okta + one test user, 4) validation call day 2 and day 7.
Carla (BlueMarlin): Sounds good. We'll provide Okta metadata and a service account for SCIM. We'll also need instructions to map Okta group names -> product roles.
Sam (SE): Mapping example (we'll send full JSON in runbook):
```\n# mapping.csv (simple csv example)\nokta_group,product_role\nblue-eng,engineer\nblue-ops,operator\n```\nAnd a quick SCIM curl to list users during the POC:
```\ncurl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \\\n  https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/scim/Users\n```\nDevon (Security): A couple of security asks: 1) where SCIM tokens are stored (we store encrypted at-rest with KMS), 2) rotation policy (we support manual rotation + expiring tokens), 3) SAML assertions signed by our SP? We require signed assertions and SHA256.
Sam (SE): We sign assertions using SHA256 by default and support both signed assertions and signed responses. SCIM tokens stored in our vault KMS; we can document rotation steps.
Carla (BlueMarlin): One more: can you show sample SCIM delta events? Our identity team wants to see 'replace' and 'remove' events used for role removal.
Sam (SE): We'll include sample delta payloads in the runbook. Example snippet (simplified):
```\nPATCH /Users/123\n{ \"schemas\": [\"urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp\"],\n  \"Operations\": [{\"op\":\"replace\",\"path\":\"groups\",\"value\": [{\"value\":\"blue-ops\"}]}]\n}\n```\nNina (AE): Procurement question: does SCIM or SSO trigger extra licensing costs for hosted? BlueMarlin wants cost clarity before kickoff.
Devon (Security): Pricing note: SSO/SCIM included on hosted standard; enterprise features (mTLS, extended retention, static egress IPs) are add-ons or Dedicated. Nina, we'll need to coordinate with finance for a short-term POC concession.
Carla (BlueMarlin): We may need a one-week extension on retention if review takes longer. Can that be adjusted post-POC?
Devon (Security): Yes, retention add-ons can be applied retroactively to keep logs longer, but legal needs to sign the amendment. We'll document options.
Sam (SE): Action items: \n- I'll publish the POC runbook + mapping examples to the runbook link.\n- DM egress IP ranges to Carla.\n- Provide SP metadata file and sample assertion.\nNina (AE): I'll open a purchase order attachment for the POC and loop in legal for the retention amendment.
Carla (BlueMarlin): We'll send Okta metadata and the SCIM service account creds by tomorrow. Thanks.
Nina (AE): Great — closing the loop: kickoff Wed 10am PT. :calendar:
